Walmart earlier officially announced that after more than a decade of delay, it will finally begin to support Apple Pay.

When will the Walmart stores near you start accepting Apple Pay? I have obtained the complete rollout schedule; here are all the details...

Walmart Apple Pay Rollout Schedule

Walmart stated in today's announcement that Apple Pay and other broader contactless payment support will begin rolling out next week, with full availability expected across all stores in the United States by the end of this year.

According to an internal memo obtained by 9to5Mac, the retailer sent the relevant information to store management today, offering more detailed phased rollout information. The company currently plans to roll out gradually on a state-by-state basis. If any issues arise during the rollout, these dates may be adjusted. Here is the current roadmap:

States Tap to Pay Launch Arkansas Aug. 24–31 California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Idaho, Alaska, Hawaii Sept. 10 Kansas, Louisiana, Nebraska, Oklahoma Sept. 14 Texas Sept. 17 Arizona, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, South Dakota, Montana, North Dakota, Wyoming Sept. 21 Illinois, Ohio, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa Sept. 24 Tennessee, Indiana, Michigan, Kentucky Sept. 28 Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi Oct. 1 Florida Oct. 5 North Carolina, Virginia, South Carolina, West Virginia, Puerto Rico Oct. 8 Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Maryland, Connecticut, New Hampshire, Maine, Delaware, Rhode Island, Vermont, District of Columbia Oct. 12

Missouri is currently not listed on Walmart's schedule for unknown reasons.

In this memo, Walmart also listed all the contactless payment methods that will be supported:

  • Contactless credit and debit cards
  • Digital wallets, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay
  • Smartwatches and wearable devices with payment capabilities
  • Supported contactless EBT cards

Walmart really took its time before adopting Apple Pay. Will this change where you choose to shop? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
